function.name: GitHubSearchRepositories
function.description: Search for repositories by keywords and scope. The user can search all repositories on Github, owned repositories, or member repositories. When the keywords are not provided, the user can search for all repositories in the specified scope.

keywords.description: The keywords to search for in the repositories. Default is search for all repositories in the specified scope.

search_scope.description: The scope of the search. Can be 'all' (all repositories on Github), 'owned' (only repositories the user owns), 'member' (only repositories where the user is a collaborator on). Default is 'all'.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is 5, maximum is 10.

policy_description.description: A brief description of the policy.

policy_type.description: The type of the policy. One of ['whitelist', 'blacklist'].

domains.description: An array of strings, each string is a domain to be added to the policy.
